A '''laserboard''' was a piece of technology used to display information. One such laserboard was present in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Eliior]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Romin]] and extolled the virtues of the planet's dictator, [[Roy Teda]].<ref name="Changing of the Guard" />
